E_corner.adjacency_bound: |d(10,8) - d(10,9)| = 16 <= min(size_10,8, size_10,9)  =>  both states have at least 16 cells
E_corner.the_12_in_61_is_NOT_the_state_of_10_9: if (10,9) sat in a 12-cell state then the step (10,8)->(10,9) would cost at most 12, so d(10,8) <= 12 + 61 = 73 < 77.  The published 77 REFUTES it.
